parent_not_edited: the parent freeze is preserved unchanged. It contains both an equation phrasing and a cadence phrasing; this record resolves which is authoritative, prospectively, rather than pretending the ambiguity never existed.
authoritative_phrasing: 1 anchor minibatch per four PPO actor minibatches

implementation_semantics.1: four ordinary PPO actor minibatches execute UNCHANGED
implementation_semantics.2: after the fourth completed actor minibatch, execute ONE separate anchor-only optimizer step
implementation_semantics.4: anchor gradients are NOT combined with PPO surrogate, value, entropy, latent, separation, communication, or strategy-objective gradients in the same backward pass
implementation_semantics.6: no trailing anchor update after fewer than four completed PPO actor minibatches

why_reading_2.literal: 'an anchor minibatch' is a minibatch, not a loss term
why_reading_2.test_3_becomes_structural: with anchoring disabled no extra optimizer step exists, so the PPO path is untouched BY CONSTRUCTION rather than verified within floating-point tolerance inside a 976-line, 61-branch loss assembly
why_reading_2.no_clipping_interaction: the anchor gradient cannot distort PPO's ratio/clipping behaviour on a minibatch, because it never shares a backward pass with the clipped surrogate
why_reading_2.interpretability: two clean operations -- PPO optimizes performance, rehearsal restores strategic memory -- instead of a hybrid loss whose gradients interact inside PPO's clipping machinery
why_reading_2.accepted_cost: anchor and PPO gradients never combine within a step, so coupling is slightly weaker than a joint loss. Acceptable for a deliberately boring V1 that asks only whether rehearsal prevents drift.

disabled_means_structurally_absent.requirement: when anchoring is disabled, the anchor operation is SKIPPED ENTIRELY
disabled_means_structurally_absent.prohibited: loss = 0.0 * anchor_loss; loss.backward(); optimizer.step() -- a nominal zero-loss step can still mutate optimizer state, step counters, schedulers, or apply weight decay
must_not_occur_when_disabled: any anchor RNG consumption that could shift PPO sampling

anchor_step_scope.optimizes: parameters reachable from the EXISTING actor distribution, to raise pi(a_teacher | o)
anchor_step_scope.architectural_sharing: if the actor shares upstream representation with other components, that EXISTING sharing is documented, not redesigned. The one-change story is preserved.

test_3_requirements.claim: SAPPO disabled reproduces the pre-SAPPO trainer path
test_3_requirements.fixture: strongest deterministic CPU fixture available; GPU nondeterminism is not an excuse to weaken the assertion

test_6_requirements.partial_group_rule: do NOT invent a trailing anchor update to force the ratio. Report raw counts and N_anchor / floor(N_ppo_actor/4) == 1 for scheduled complete groups.
test_6_requirements.why_measured: an implementation can be logically correct while a loop-nesting mistake yields 1:1 or 1:16 rehearsal. The cadence must be measured, not asserted from the configured constant.

unchanged_from_parent: same-style anchors only (pi_A <- GUARD, pi_B <- BREACH)
evaluation on 7800001..7800192 with the identical R2 gate
LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0 as the only scientific verdict

stale_gradient_hazard_LAUNCH_BLOCKER.hazard: gradients left over from the preceding PPO backward pass can participate in the anchor optimizer step. Everything runs, counters still report 0.25, and the 'NLL-only rehearsal' claim is silently false.
required_sequence: 4 PPO actor minibatches, each with its own optimizer step
required_assertions_after_anchor_backwar: actor parameters reachable from the teacher NLL HAVE gradients
locked/ineligible agents remain zero (already covered by test_2b)
critic-only parameters carry NO stale gradient
unrelated objective heads (latent, separation, communication, strategy) carry NO stale gradient
the anchor optimizer step changes ONLY parameters reachable from the teacher NLL through the existing shared architecture
stale_gradient_hazard_LAUNCH_BLOCKER.legitimate_vs_illegitimate: if the actor shares an encoder, shared parameters changing is LEGITIMATE. What must not happen is a parameter update caused by leftover gradients from PPO/value/latent/comm/strategy losses.
stale_gradient_hazard_LAUNCH_BLOCKER.status: LAUNCH BLOCKER -- must be asserted by test before the +500k run
